_comment: T-03 gravity sweep — 2× nominal | M3 × abrupt × 5 seeds × 1M steps
_purpose: Characterise detection envelope at 2× gravity (g=-19.62 m/s²). Part of T-03 gravity boundary sweep. See planned_tests.md T-03 and tuning_journal.md T-03.
_parameters: floor=2e-4 (instrument.json), m_fail=2 (instrument.json) — both locked by T-01/T-02.
_why_M3_only: M3 is the weakest monitor condition (longest windows). If detection works at M3, it works everywhere. Restricting to M3 × abrupt keeps T-03 to 5 runs instead of 45.
